214954|6cf4abd2.name: Rix Xizzix
214954|6cf4abd2.text:
Welcome to the Xizzix Asset Recovery Service! If you lost it, we probably found it! 

Check my stock to see if we've recovered anything that you might have carelessly discarded and have since decided you just can't live without.

7161|4df495bf.name: Wrenix the Wretched
7161|4df495bf.text: Pirates. I hate them. I don't just hate them; I despise them with every fiber of my being. What with all the 'ARRRRR!' and 'YARRR!' and those awful birds they keep as pets - how could anyone stand pirates, let alone be a pirate?

2381-progress.name: Wrenix the Wretched
2381-progress.text: Well, at least you still have all of your body parts. Did you find the treasure?
2381-progress.title: Plundering the Plunderers

7820-progress.name: Rumstag Proudstrider
7820-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Thunder Bluff for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7820-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

890-progress.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
